responsibilities: The role involves designing, building, migrating, and optimizing modern Database and Business Intelligence architectures across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments.

The specialist will lead secure and scalable database design, conceptual/logical/physical data modeling, procedural programming (PL/SQL, PL/pgSQL), release/deployment scripting, performance tuning, and the implementation of complex ETL/ELT pipelines and analytics solutions.

Working within structured European management frameworks (PM² and Agile methodologies), the position requires high technical rigor, data quality enforcement, and secure management of sensitive operational information.

In close collaboration with project leads, service managers, developers, analysts, and cross-functional international teams, the specialist will translate complex functional needs into scalable, secure, and high-performing database and data engineering solutions.
